comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body: Usually for high ranking quests they can be pretty hard to pull. I dont think I had any difficulty pulling this quest. But if it's been over 180 qmp + 5 sqmp and the quest is still failing to appear, I'm sure your missing something. Either A) you have not done the pre-quest(s) listed above, B) your Adventure fame is too low (I'm unable to find how much is needed to pull this exactly), or C) You dont have the needed ranks listed above (there are several quests that wont appear until you have the actual requirements. You can use booster equipment to get there).
